  Scenario: AC7 Every business rule of section 8 is covered by a criterion and a test case (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the business rules BR1 to BR11 of section 8
    When each rule row is checked against sections 7 and 16
    Then each rule names at least one criterion and one test case that the document declares
    Then each rule that is an architecture constraint is checked by a contract or boundary test of section 16

  Scenario: AC8 A provided operation answers 404 as one problem response (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the error envelope component of the document
    When a provided operation is called for a template version that does not exist
    Then the answer is 404 with one RFC 9457 problem response carrying type, title, status, detail, instance, messageId and traceId
    Then the messageId of the 404 is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P4-E8010-CON-AC8)
    Then no operation declares a second error shape for the 404

  Scenario: AC9 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a template version in state APPROVED or WITHDRAWN
    When an approval of that version is requested
    Then the answer is 409 with MSG-GEN-004 and the version is unchanged
    Then this service makes no state change other than DRAFT to APPROVED
